page.overview:
Who is Computer Princess?

Computer Princess, sometimes referred to as CP or Cece, is the creator and ruler of Computer Kingdom. In the 2025 comic book series she serves a similar narrative role to early-series Princess Bubblegum as Finn's primary quest-giver.

Years prior to the events of the comic series, Computer Princess had been installed in the outskirts of Candy Kingdom. While she was working on building her own kingdom, she also volunteered to repair any technology that had been in a state of disrepair while the Lich rampaged through Ooo. While offering her services to the people of Ooo, she met Billy when he came seeking her assistance as he felt he wasn't strong enough to defeat the Lich on his own. Coming up with the idea to build a robot doppelganger of Billy to help defeat the Lich, she studied his biometrics and recorded as much data on Billy as she could to effectively create a perfect clone of Billy at that exact moment in time. While working on this robotic clone, she also met Canyon. At some point, Computer Princess was aware of Canyon's pregnancy with Ravine and offered to build a robot clone of Ravine as well.

After Billy succeeded in defeating the Lich and retiring unannounced, it had begun raining. The rain resulted in a flood that washed away what Computer Princess had built of her kingdom, with Computer Princess lamenting that she forgot to save her progress during this time. After losing her kingdom, she seemed to have been staying in the Candy Kingdom with Princess Bubblegum and possibly Marceline. It's currently unclear what happened to Computer Princess after this, as when she introduces herself to Finn she refers to herself as having been recently reinstalled. After her reinstallation, she had also rebuilt her kingdom. She begins the series as someone who had been travelling around Ooo and recording data on the cultures and habitants of the land in fear of losing information about the world around her. After meeting Finn and Jake, she sends them on a quest to find the Enchiridion as part of her archival project.

She is consistently depicted as having pale, metallic skin that ranges between a pure white to a light shade of blue. Similarly her hair ranges between being similar in color to her skin, to various shades of blue that are typically more vibrant than her skin. Instead of legs, she appears to have a mechanism that appears similar to a bicycle fork with a single small wheel.
